html:
The division of Korea began in August 1945, when the United States and the Soviet Union agreed to split the peninsula at the 38th parallel to take the Japanese surrender, and became permanent with two Korean states in 1948.

Two American officers picked the line in a hurry one night. Soviet troops held the north and the Americans the south, ending Japanese rule. Plans for a joint trusteeship failed as the Cold War set in. In 1948 the Republic of Korea was founded in Seoul in August, and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea in Pyongyang on 9 September, under Kim Il Sung.

Each claimed the whole peninsula. In 1950 the North invaded, starting the Korean War, which ended with the line little changed. Millions of families were split and most never met again.
sum: The division of Korea began in August 1945, when the United States and the Soviet Union agreed to split the peninsula at the 38th parallel to take the Japanese surrender, and became permanent with two Korean states in 1948.
